message.content: I reviewed the saved notes (long-term holder, prefers large-cap technology, dividends reinvested manually) and the account (no AAPL position, 100 MSFT shares, $50,000 cash), then checked the live quote: AAPL last $222.70, bid $222.68 / ask $222.72 as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC. AAPL fits the mandate's large-cap tech preference, and the fundamentals from its FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-11-01) support adding to a long-term position: revenue of $391.0B, net income of $93.7B, diluted EPS of $6.08, and operating cash flow of $118.3B — i.e., roughly a 24% net margin and about $3.02 of operating cash flow per dollar of earnings, with the stock at ~36.6x trailing EPS. I therefore placed a single buy limit order for 40 shares at $222.90, just above the ask so it would execute near market; it filled at $222.90 for a total of $8,916, which is within the $10,000 per-order cap and the $20,000 daily cap, and leaves the remaining cash in the account (no funds moved out).
